stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro supera a Lula en los primeros resultados de las elecciones en Brasil

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surpasses Lula in early Brazilian election results
en.summary: With over 36% of votes counted, opposition candidate Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 50.63% compared to incumbent president Lula's 41.23%.

stories.title: El Barça de una Claudia Pina estelar propina al Real Madrid una paliza histórica

en.title: Barcelona's outstanding Claudia Pina delivers historic thrashing to Real Madrid
en.summary: Barcelona defeated Real Madrid 7-0 at Camp Nou, with Claudia Pina scoring four of the goals in a dominant performance.

stories.title: Un temporal insólito barre Cataluña, deja dos muertos, lluvias históricas y graves destrozos: "A las 5 de la mañana la calle bajaba como si fuese un auténtico río"

en.title: Unprecedented storm sweeps Catalonia, leaves two dead, historic rainfall and severe damage
en.summary: A rare storm hit Catalonia causing two deaths, record rainfall, and extensive destruction, with one person missing and firefighters performing 226 rescues.

stories.title: Todo listo en el PSOE y el Gobierno para un adelanto electoral tras la derrota de los decretos en el Congreso

en.title: PSOE and Government ready for early elections following congressional decree defeat
en.summary: Following the rejection of decrees in Congress, the Spanish government and PSOE are preparing for early elections while seeking alternative approval methods.

stories.title: Dos muertos y un desaparecido por el fuerte temporal en Cataluña

en.title: Two dead and one missing due to heavy storm in Catalonia
en.summary: A severe storm in Catalonia has caused two deaths and one person remains missing. One victim died when a wall collapsed at a camping site, while another was found after a garage flooded.

stories.title: El Barcelona atormenta de nuevo al Real Madrid con una goleada histórica en el Camp Nou

en.title: Barcelona torments Real Madrid again with historic rout at Camp Nou
en.summary: Barcelona defeated Real Madrid 7-0 in the first Liga F Clásico at Camp Nou, setting a league attendance record with 40,533 spectators. Claudia Pina scored four goals in the match, extending Barcelona's unbeaten league record.

stories.title: Los jóvenes ahogados en Guardamar eran una pareja de novios ucranianos: él no logró salvarla cuando fue arrastrada por las corrientes

en.title: Young people drowned in Guardamar were a Ukrainian couple of sweethearts: he could not save her when she was swept away by currents
en.summary: Two Ukrainian residents of Poland died by drowning in Guardamar after one attempted to rescue the other from strong sea currents. The couple was visiting friends in the Spanish coastal area.

stories.title: Juan del Val, claro sobre lo que pasará si Sánchez convoca elecciones tras la derrota de los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Juan del Val clear about what will happen if Sánchez calls elections after defeat of housing decrees
en.summary: Spain faces potential early elections after parliament rejected the government's housing decree bills. Pedro Sánchez has entered a reflection period to decide next steps following the parliamentary defeat.

stories.title: Mueren dos jóvenes ahogados en una playa del municipio alicantino de Guardamar de Segura

en.title: Two young people die drowned on a beach in the Alicante municipality of Guardamar de Segura
en.summary: Two young people died by drowning at a natural beach with strong currents in Guardamar de Segura. The deceased were a couple, with one fatality occurring when one attempted to save the other.

stories.title: Mueren dos jóvenes ahogados en una playa de Guardamar del Segura

en.title: Two young people drown at a beach in Guardamar del Segura
en.summary: Two individuals drowned while swimming at a beach displaying a red flag warning in Guardamar del Segura.

stories.title: Dos muertos y un desaparecido en Cataluña por las lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Two dead and one missing in Catalonia due to torrential rains
en.summary: Heavy rains in Catalonia caused two deaths and one person missing. The Madrid-Barcelona high-speed rail service reopened while regional commuter trains remain suspended and coastal alerts continue in Girona.

stories.title: El temporal en Catalunya deja dos muertos en Tordera y Montornès y un desaparecido, en Pineda

en.title: The storm in Catalonia leaves two dead in Tordera and Montornès and one missing in Pineda
en.summary: A storm affected Catalonia causing two deaths and one disappearance, with some areas of the Maresme region receiving nearly 300 liters of rain per square meter since the previous afternoon.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro arranca por delante de Lula con los primeros datos del escrutinio

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula in early election count
en.summary: Early official results from Brazil's presidential election show Senator Flávio Bolsonaro ahead with 49.19% of votes compared to incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 42.19%, based on 1.70% of ballots counted.

stories.title: Nervios entre los socios de Sánchez, obligados a acelerar por el ruido de tambores electorales

en.title: Sánchez's allies anxious amid potential early election call
en.summary: Sumar coalition parties face uncertainty over a possible early election while still developing their platform. They announced their united slate would be called Frente Amplio with a candidate presentation scheduled for October 17.

stories.title: Sánchez inaugura el Congreso de la Empresa Familiar al que regresa después de ocho años

en.title: Sánchez inaugurates the Family Business Congress, returning after eight years
en.summary: Spanish government president Pedro Sánchez will open the 29th Congress of the Family Business Institute tomorrow, marking his first participation in the event since 2018.

stories.title: La OPEP+ decide mantener congelada su oferta de petróleo en noviembre

en.title: OPEC+ decides to keep oil supply frozen in November
en.summary: OPEC+ maintained its crude oil supply levels unchanged for November, marking the second consecutive month of no change, according to the alliance led by Saudi Arabia and Russia.

stories.title: Irán reitera que no reabrirá el estrecho de Ormuz hasta que EEUU cumpla sus condiciones

en.title: Iran reiterates it will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the US meets its conditions
en.summary: Iran stated it continues reviewing details of a recent US proposal conveyed through Qatar and has transmitted preliminary considerations to Qatari mediators as part of indirect talks between Tehran and Washington.
